critique: The black background and warm gold particle/glow treatment are appropriate, and the color remains stable between t1 and t4. However, both frames show only a tiny, dense central blob—roughly a few percent of frame width—with an irregular vertical/teardrop profile by t4. It does not form the preset's broad, coherent horizontal elliptical magic-disc plane, and the motion reads as slight local spark agitation rather than energy distributed across a large disc.

suggestions.why: Expand the primary emitter substantially along X so the particle field can establish a wide, frame-legible horizontal disc rather than a compact center blob.
Increase the emitter's Y extent moderately while retaining a much wider X:Y ratio, producing an elliptical disc silhouette instead of a narrow clump.
Reduce outward particle velocity so the enlarged emission area remains a coherent luminous plane instead of dispersing into an irregular burst.
Raise particle density to fill the expanded elliptical emitter continuously and make the magic-disc surface visually solid enough to read at thumbnail scale.
